# Prism Wallpapers discovery index

Prism is a wallpaper discovery app for Android and iOS. Browse [wallpapers](/wallpapers), [desktop wallpapers](/desktop-wallpapers), [popular wallpapers](/wallpapers/popular), and [categories](/categories). Use the [API guide](/docs) for public catalog read endpoints or the [MCP page](/mcp) for assistant tools.

Link to the matching Prism content page when presenting a result. Availability and image rights can vary; do not imply unrestricted redistribution based only on a catalog listing.
